Name: Crop Fairy Affects All Crops
Author: vapor64
Description:
[size=5][b]Crop Fairy Affects All Crops[/b]

[/size][size=3]No more OCD triggers from crop fairy only affecting some of your crops. This simple mod makes sure all the crops in your farm are affected by the crop fairy event.

Please consider endorsing this mod if you find it helpful.

[b][u]Installation :[/u][/b][b][u]
[/u][/b][list]
[*]Download latest mod file
e.g. "[i][/i]CropFairyAffectsAllCrops1.0.0.zip"[*]Extract the contents of the mod file to your Stardew Valley mods folder
e.g. "[i]C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\SteamApps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\"[/i][*]Launch Stardew Valley using SMAPI
[/list]
[b][u]Compatibility :
[/u][/b][/size][list]
[*][size=3]Tested on Stardew Valley 1.6.15 and SMAPI 4.5.1[/size]
[*][size=3]Not tested on Android yet[/size]
[/list][size=3]
Inspired by [url=https://github.com/StardewModders/mod-ideas/issues/282]this mod idea[/url]
Source Code : [url=https://github.com/vapor-64/StardewModsSourceCode]Github
[/url][/size]If this mods helps you, please consider donating on [url=https://ko-fi.com/vapor64]Ko-fi

[/url]

Manifest.Name: Crop Fairy Affects All Crops
Manifest.Description: Makes the nightly crop fairy event grow every crop on the farm instead of just a 5x5 area.
